narration.text: In caregiving, one small change rarely stays small. An appointment moves. A whole new plan to coordinate.
A calendar knows an appointment changed. Someone still has to connect the dots.
Meet Carestead. One shared care picture, so Maya doesn't have to keep rebuilding it in her head.

narration.speaker: maya
narration.text: Carestead, what should I know about Alex today?
Carestead connects the change to what could fall through the cracks.

narration.speaker: maya
narration.text: I won't be available Friday. What needs coverage?
It looks ahead, showing affected responsibilities and gaps in coverage.
Then, a coordinated next step. Consequential changes wait for Maya's review. Carestead helps coordinate. Maya stays in control.
When someone else steps in, the context moves with the care.
Less to remember. More room to be present.
Carestead. Less to carry. More care to give.
